name: Velocipede
speed: The Speed of the pilot (pedaled [as rowed])

items.name: Fragile
items.text: Driving the velocipede over difficult terrain increases the DC by an additional 2 and gains the reckless trait.

items.name: Portable
items.text: The velocipede can be pulled along the ground on its wheel by a Medium creature. The creature is encumbered.
